name: The End of an Era
description: A behind-the-scenes docuseries event chronicling the development, impact, and inner workings that created the phenomenon that was Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour, as well as providing an intimate look at Taylor's life as her tour made headlines and thrilled fans around the world. The series also spotlights performers, family members, and friends — including Gracie Abrams, Sabrina Carpenter, Ed Sheeran, and Florence Welch — offering never-before-seen insight into what it took to create a phenomenon.

videos.title: Welcome to The Eras Tour
videos.overview: Taylor recalls the development and rehearsals for the tour and preps for her run at Wembley Stadium.

videos.title: Magic in the Eras
videos.overview: Taylor and her crew use a two-month break to update the tour to add "THE TORTURED POETS DEPARTMENT."

videos.title: Kismet
videos.overview: As the tour heads back to the U.S., Taylor reminisces about her past and plans some new surprises.

videos.title: Thank You for the Lovely Bouquet
videos.overview: Taylor reflects on her acoustic sets, and welcomes Travis Kelce and Sabrina Carpenter to the stage.

videos.title: Marjorie
videos.overview: Taylor reveals how family inspired the tour and spotlights tour performers, including Gracie Abrams.

videos.title: Remember This Moment
videos.overview: Taylor reflects on the success and impact of The Eras Tour as she takes her final bow in Vancouver.
